name: third_person_controller
title: Third-person character controller with camera rig
summary: Camera-relative CharacterBody3D movement that turns to face travel, jump with coyote time, sprint, an interaction probe; plus the SpringArm3D camera rig that follows it as a sibling.
usage: Attach scripts/third_person_controller.gd to a CharacterBody3D (add an Area3D child named InteractRange for interaction). Add a Node3D SIBLING with scripts/camera_rig.gd, a SpringArm3D child holding the Camera3D, and set its target_path to the body. godot_character_wire installs the same controller onto an animated .glb.
